title: WeddingTask
description: One task on a wedding's checklist (issue #31): what to do, by when, and whose job it is. Created by hand or from the built-in checklist template (then `template_key` names the template item, so applying the template twice adds nothing twice). Stored under groupedKey(wedding_id, task_id) and read one wedding at a time.

task_id.description: Identity within the owning tenant's partition, from the injected id generator.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

notes.description: Free text, when there is any.

due_date.description: The local date it is due (YYYY-MM-DD).

assignee.description: Whose job it is. The couple can complete the tasks assigned to them.

template_key.description: The checklist template item this task came from, when it came from one.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time it was marked done, while done.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC creation time, from the injected clock.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last change, when changed.
